grammar_title: 时态(过去完成时·现在完成进行时·将来进行时)
source: 上外版选择性必修第一册 Unit 1 Grammar in Use:Tenses(past perfect, present perfect continuous, future continuous)。句子地道、语境唯一判定时态、答案唯一、零术语。

points.point: 过去完成时(had done:过去的过去)
points.overview: 表示在过去某一时间或动作之前已经完成的动作(过去的过去)。常与 before / by the time / when / already / by + 过去时间 连用:When I arrived, the class had begun.

points.point: 现在完成进行时(have/has been doing:持续到现在)
points.overview: 表示从过去某时开始、一直持续到现在(可能还在继续)的动作,强调动作的持续。常与 for / since / all day / lately / recently / how long 连用:She has been studying for hours.

points.point: 将来进行时(will be doing:将来正在进行)
points.overview: 表示将来某一时刻或时段正在进行的动作。常与 this time tomorrow / at + 将来时刻 / soon / when you grow up 连用:This time tomorrow I'll be flying to London.

questions.stem: By the time the visitors arrived, Curie ____ the long poem.
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去动作之前已完成 → 过去完成时 had recited。

questions.stem: When the teacher came in, the experiment ____, so we had to start again.
questions.explanation: 过去某动作(came in)之前已发生 → had failed。

questions.stem: Just nine days after he ____ his degree, the physicist sailed home.
questions.explanation: after 引导、动作早于过去的 sailed → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: Before he taught himself to write, the boy ____ with reading for years.
questions.explanation: before 过去动作之前的持续 → 过去完成时 had struggled。

questions.stem: She told us that she ____ those poems by heart long before.
questions.explanation: 主句过去 told,从句更早 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: By 1937, Deng's father ____ him a deep love of science.
questions.explanation: by + 过去年份,之前已完成 → had given。

questions.stem: When I got home, my mother ____ the books for my evening study.
questions.explanation: 过去 got home 之前已完成 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: Mandela realised that the donkey ____ him off before his friends could laugh.
questions.explanation: 过去 realised 之前发生 → had thrown。

questions.stem: After the war ____, Goodenough went to Chicago to study physics.
questions.explanation: after 过去动作之前完成 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: Darwin found that his brother ____ a small laboratory in the garden.
questions.explanation: 过去 found,从句动作更早 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: By the end of that summer, he ____ several books on chemistry.
questions.explanation: by the end of + 过去时间 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: She wanted to run away because she ____ never ____ in front of strangers before.
questions.explanation: 过去 wanted 之前的'从未……过' → 过去完成时 had recited。

questions.stem: The class was over; clearly the bell ____ a few minutes earlier.
questions.explanation: 过去 was over 之前更早发生 → had rung。

questions.stem: Until he climbed the hill, he ____ how much farther one could see.
questions.explanation: until + 过去动作之前一直未……→ 过去完成时。

questions.stem: He said the wise man ____ himself every day before his conduct grew faultless.
questions.explanation: 过去 said,更早的反省 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: By the time she finished school, she ____ a strong taste for poetry.
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: When the prize was announced, Goodenough ____ already ____ ninety-seven.
questions.explanation: 过去 announced 之前已发生 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: He admitted that he ____ that lesson from the donkey years before.
questions.explanation: 过去 admitted,更早的 learned → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: Before the steamship reached China, the young man ____ how to serve his country.
questions.explanation: before 过去动作之前 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: No sooner ____ he ____ his Ph.D. than he joined a research lab.
questions.explanation: no sooner ... than 句型用过去完成时。

questions.stem: Our motherland ____ from the attack for so long, the father said sadly.
questions.explanation: for so long、持续到现在并强调持续 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: I ____ on my English recently, so I feel much more confident now.
questions.explanation: recently + 持续到现在 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: He ____ in the Go Green Club since last October.
questions.explanation: since + 过去时间点、持续至今 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: She ____ long poems by heart all afternoon and is still going.
questions.explanation: all afternoon + 仍在继续 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: I ____ to English radio every day for months to get used to the speed.
questions.explanation: for months + 持续动作 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: How long ____ you ____ reading exercises under your teacher's guidance?
questions.explanation: how long + 持续到现在 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: Goodenough ____ new types of batteries since he was a young man.
questions.explanation: since + 从句、持续至今 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: I ____ from you lately—how has your study been going?
questions.explanation: lately + 强调一段时间 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: My sense of responsibility ____ steadily ever since I joined the club.
questions.explanation: ever since + 持续发展 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: They ____ wild honey in the fields all day, and their baskets are nearly full.
questions.explanation: all day + 仍在进行 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: He ____ at chemistry hard for weeks, so his hands are stained with dye.
questions.explanation: for weeks + 现在仍有结果 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: We ____ on this design project since early spring without a break.
questions.explanation: since early spring + 持续 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: Why are your eyes so red? — I ____ for the test since this morning.
questions.explanation: since this morning + 持续到现在(眼睛红) → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: The old pianist ____ with his teacher for years and still practises weekly.
questions.explanation: for years + 仍在继续 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: I ____ a lot of reading exercises lately, and my marks are improving.
questions.explanation: lately + 持续到现在并有结果 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: She ____ about lifelong learning ever since she read that book.
questions.explanation: ever since + 持续 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: They ____ to reduce food waste in the canteen for the whole term.
questions.explanation: for the whole term + 持续至今 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: How long ____ he ____ in this laboratory? — Since he was thirty.
questions.explanation: how long ... since → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: I ____ my own voice and comparing it with the host's for a month now.
questions.explanation: for a month now + 持续 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: My twin sister ____ for the chemistry exam since breakfast, and looks tired.
questions.explanation: since breakfast + 持续到现在 → 现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: I ____ for my country soon, the young scientist said on the ship.
questions.explanation: soon + 将来正在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: For the country's future, you ____ science when you grow up.
questions.explanation: when you grow up + 将来正在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: This time next week she ____ an important English test.
questions.explanation: this time next week + 将来某刻在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: Next Friday we ____ kindergarten kids how to reuse glass bottles.
questions.explanation: next Friday + 将来某时进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: This time tomorrow my sister ____ an experiment in the lab.
questions.explanation: this time tomorrow + 将来正在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: Don't call me at nine; I ____ a long passage for the speech contest.
questions.explanation: at nine(将来时刻)+ 在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: At this moment next month, he ____ batteries in his Oxford laboratory.
questions.explanation: at this moment next month + 将来在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: By eight tomorrow evening, the students ____ for their group project.
questions.explanation: by eight tomorrow evening(将来时段)+ 在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: When you arrive at the club, we ____ ways to reduce food waste.
questions.explanation: 将来 when 时间状语 + 在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: This time tomorrow afternoon, Jack ____ the piano with his teacher.
questions.explanation: this time tomorrow afternoon + 在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: Don't worry—at ten o'clock the host ____ the same programme as usual.
questions.explanation: at ten o'clock(将来)+ 例行进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: This weekend the volunteers ____ younger children with their reading.
questions.explanation: this weekend + 将来在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: By next term, I hope I ____ my own voice every day to improve.
questions.explanation: by next term + 将来在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: At noon tomorrow the team ____ their plan for the learning festival.
questions.explanation: at noon tomorrow + 在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: This time next year, many of us ____ at different universities.
questions.explanation: this time next year + 将来某刻在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: When you call me tonight, I ____ for the listening test.
questions.explanation: 将来 tonight + when 时间状语,在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: At this time on Saturday, the children ____ lanterns and paper cranes.
questions.explanation: at this time on Saturday + 在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: Soon he ____ his birthday party, so he is busy preparing now.
questions.explanation: soon + 将来在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: This time tomorrow, the interviewer ____ students about learning by doing.
questions.explanation: this time tomorrow + 在进行 → 将来进行时。

questions.stem: At three o'clock next Monday, we ____ to old people at the nursing home.
questions.explanation: at three o'clock next Monday + 将来在进行 → 将来进行时。
